text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Stem borer: Cutoff range is <5% dead hearts (veg) or <1% white ears (rep). Symptom: Scattered yellowing leaves with isolated dead heart shoots that pull out easily; minimal egg mass activity.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Stem borer: Cutoff range is 6%-10% dead hearts (veg) or 1%-5% white ears (rep). Symptom: Reaches ETL; noticeable dead hearts across tillers and initial white earhead formation; larvae boring inside stem base.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Stem borer: Cutoff range is 11%-25% dead hearts (veg) or 6%-15% white ears (rep). Symptom: Widespread tiller death and prominent erect white panicles devoid of grain; substantial yield reduction underway.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Stem borer: Cutoff range is >25% dead hearts or >15% white ears. Symptom: Catastrophic crop collapse; majority of tillers severed internally; complete panicle sterility across field.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Brown planthopper (BPH): Cutoff range is 1-5 nymphs/hill (veg). Symptom: Initial nymph colonization at base of tillers; slight yellowing of lowest older leaves; no lodging.
provenance: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank & TNAU Agritech

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Brown planthopper (BPH): Cutoff range is 6-15 nymphs/hill (veg) or 10-20 nymphs/hill (rep). Symptom: Reaches ETL; noticeable yellowing extending up tiller canopy; visible honeydew excretion and sooty mold at tiller base.
provenance: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank & TNAU Agritech

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Brown planthopper (BPH): Cutoff range is 16-30 nymphs/hill. Symptom: Severe sap depletion; localized circular drying patches (early hopper burn); tillers wilting and becoming brittle.
provenance: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank & TNAU Agritech

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Brown planthopper (BPH): Cutoff range is >30 nymphs/hill with coalescing hopper burn. Symptom: Widespread contiguous hopper burn patches spreading across field; crop collapse and complete plant drying.
provenance: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank & TNAU Agritech

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Leaf folder: Cutoff range is <5% folded leaves, <1 larva/2-3 hills. Symptom: Isolated folded leaves with fine white scraped longitudinal streaks; plant growth largely unaffected.

Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Leaf folder: Cutoff range is 6%-15% folded leaves (or 5%-10% damaged flag leaves at booting). Symptom: Reaches ETL; multiple folded leaves per hill; larvae actively scraping chlorophyll from inside rolls.

metadata.name: Leaf folder
metadata.cutoff_range: 6%-15% folded leaves (or 5%-10% damaged flag leaves at booting)

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Leaf folder: Cutoff range is 16%-30% folded leaves. Symptom: Severe leaf rolling across canopy; significant photosynthesis reduction; white papery appearance on upper third of crop.

Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Leaf folder: Cutoff range is >30% folded leaves. Symptom: Whitish scorched field appearance across entire parcel; extensive flag leaf destruction leading to grain unfilled chaffiness.

Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Green leafhopper (GLH): Cutoff range is <5 hoppers/hill (non-endemic) or <1 hopper/hill (Tungro area). Symptom: Low adult activity; slight tip yellowing; no virus transmission symptoms detected.
provenance: ICAR Rice Production Manual — Green Leafhopper

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Green leafhopper (GLH): Cutoff range is 6-15 hoppers/hill (veg) or 1-2 hoppers/hill (Tungro endemic). Symptom: Reaches ETL; active hopper jumping in canopy; margin chlorosis developing on middle leaves.
provenance: ICAR Rice Production Manual — Green Leafhopper

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Green leafhopper (GLH): Cutoff range is 16-30 hoppers/hill. Symptom: Heavy sap drainage; widespread yellow-orange leaf discoloration; stunted tiller vigor.
provenance: ICAR Rice Production Manual — Green Leafhopper

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Green leafhopper (GLH): Cutoff range is >30 hoppers/hill or active Tungro epidemic spreading. Symptom: Complete leaf chlorosis or virulent Rice Tungro Virus spreading with pronounced stunting and sterile panicles.

metadata.name: Green leafhopper (GLH)
metadata.cutoff_range: >30 hoppers/hill or active Tungro epidemic spreading

provenance: ICAR Rice Production Manual — Green Leafhopper

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Gall midge: Cutoff range is 1%-4% silver shoots at tillering. Symptom: Occasional silver shoots (onion galls) visible at tiller base; plant compensation still possible.
provenance: TNAU Gall Midge Management & ICAR Manual

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Gall midge: Cutoff range is 5%-10% silver shoots. Symptom: Reaches ETL; prominent silver shoots causing sterile tiller loss in 5-10% of shoots.
provenance: TNAU Gall Midge Management & ICAR Manual

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Gall midge: Cutoff range is 11%-25% silver shoots. Symptom: Extensive tiller galling; high percentage of shoots unable to develop productive earheads.
provenance: TNAU Gall Midge Management & ICAR Manual

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Gall midge: Cutoff range is >25% silver shoots. Symptom: Massive tiller destruction across field; stunted bushy appearance of hills with severe yield collapse.
provenance: TNAU Gall Midge Management & ICAR Manual

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Thrips: Cutoff range is 1-4 thrips/seedling in nursery. Symptom: Minute silvery spots on upper leaf surfaces; mild inward rolling of leaf tips.

Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Thrips: Cutoff range is 5-10 thrips/seedling (nursery) or 10-25 thrips/hill (tillering). Symptom: Reaches ETL; conspicuous needle-like leaf rolling; tips drying and yellowing.
Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Thrips: Cutoff range is >25 thrips/hill, >50% rolled leaves. Symptom: Extensive leaf curling and drying across seedling bed; scorched appearance of nursery.

Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Thrips: Cutoff range is Complete nursery seedling mortality or field-wide dry-out. Symptom: Death of nursery seedlings under moisture stress; complete loss of transplantable nursery stand.

metadata.name: Thrips
metadata.cutoff_range: Complete nursery seedling mortality or field-wide dry-out

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Whorl maggot: Cutoff range is <5% damaged leaves within 30 DAT. Symptom: Small yellowish feeding streaks on newly expanded central leaves; seedling vigor unaffected.
provenance: TNAU Whorl Maggot Management in Rice

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Whorl maggot: Cutoff range is 6%-15% damaged leaves. Symptom: Reaches ETL; ragged serrated leaf margins visible on multiple expanding leaves per hill.
provenance: TNAU Whorl Maggot Management in Rice

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Whorl maggot: Cutoff range is 16%-30% damaged leaves. Symptom: Conspicuous broken serrated leaf blades and distorted central whorls across the plot.
provenance: TNAU Whorl Maggot Management in Rice

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Whorl maggot: Cutoff range is >30% damaged leaves with severe seedling stunting. Symptom: Severe plant stunting, delayed tillering, and general stand vigor reduction in flooded fields.

metadata.name: Whorl maggot
metadata.cutoff_range: >30% damaged leaves with severe seedling stunting

provenance: TNAU Whorl Maggot Management in Rice

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Earhead bug: Cutoff range is 1-4 bugs/100 panicles (<1 bug/hill). Symptom: Isolated adult bugs feeding during morning hours; rare localized brownish puncture spots on glumes.
provenance: ICAR Rice Insect Pest Management Manual

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Earhead bug: Cutoff range is 5-10 bugs/100 panicles (1-2 bugs/hill). Symptom: Reaches ETL; milky grains being pierced; foul odor noticeable upon entering field; brown spots on maturing grains.
provenance: ICAR Rice Insect Pest Management Manual

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Earhead bug: Cutoff range is 11-25 bugs/100 panicles (2-4 bugs/hill). Symptom: Numerous damaged, shriveled, partially filled grains with blackened feeding punctures; strong pungent odor.
provenance: ICAR Rice Insect Pest Management Manual

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Earhead bug: Cutoff range is >25 bugs/100 panicles (>4 bugs/hill). Symptom: Massive grain loss; over 30% empty/chaffy erect panicles; severe economic devaluation of grain lot.
provenance: ICAR Rice Insect Pest Management Manual

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB): Cutoff range is 1%-5% leaf area affected. Symptom: Water-soaked translucent stripes along leaf margins; yellow-orange wavy margins on isolated upper leaves.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB): Cutoff range is 6%-12% leaf area affected. Symptom: Lesions expanding along leaf blade with characteristic wavy margins and milky bacterial ooze beads on damp mornings.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB): Cutoff range is 13%-25% leaf area affected. Symptom: Lesions coalescing; blighting of upper leaves including flag leaf; early kresek (systemic wilting) on susceptible varieties.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB): Cutoff range is >25%-50% leaf area affected or severe kresek phase. Symptom: Complete leaf drying, systemic kresek wilting of entire hills, premature crop lodging and severe unfilled grains.

metadata.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB)
metadata.cutoff_range: >25%-50% leaf area affected or severe kresek phase

provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Rice Blast: Cutoff range is <1%-5% leaf area with pinhead/small spindle lesions. Symptom: Small brown specks or circular to spindle-shaped lesions (1-2 mm) with grey center on lower canopy leaves.

metadata.name: Rice Blast
metadata.cutoff_range: <1%-5% leaf area with pinhead/small spindle lesions

provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Rice Blast: Cutoff range is 6%-10% leaf area with typical spindle-shaped lesions. Symptom: Typical spindle-shaped lesions (0.5-1.5 cm) with grey/whitish centers and dark reddish-brown borders on middle leaves.

metadata.name: Rice Blast
metadata.cutoff_range: 6%-10% leaf area with typical spindle-shaped lesions

provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Rice Blast: Cutoff range is 11%-25% leaf area affected or initial neck blast. Symptom: Lesions coalescing causing leaf necrosis; blackish-brown lesion developing at panicle node/neck (early neck blast).

metadata.name: Rice Blast
metadata.cutoff_range: 11%-25% leaf area affected or initial neck blast

provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Rice Blast: Cutoff range is >25% leaf area affected or >10% rotten neck blast. Symptom: Complete leaf canopy burning; neck blast causing snapping of panicle base and complete chaffiness of earhead.

metadata.name: Rice Blast
metadata.cutoff_range: >25% leaf area affected or >10% rotten neck blast

provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Sheath Blight: Cutoff range is RLH <= 20% (lesions restricted to lower sheaths near waterline). Symptom: Oval or greenish-grey water-soaked lesions on leaf sheaths just above the water level.

metadata.name: Sheath Blight
metadata.cutoff_range: RLH <= 20% (lesions restricted to lower sheaths near waterline)

provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Sheath Blight: Cutoff range is RLH 21%-40% (lesions reaching 3rd or 4th leaf sheath). Symptom: Lesions enlarging with irregular brownish borders and grey-white centers; spreading upward along tillers.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Sheath Blight: Cutoff range is RLH 41%-60% (lesions reaching flag leaf sheath). Symptom: Lesions coalescing and reaching the flag leaf sheath and collar; white sclerotia visible on lesions.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Sheath Blight: Cutoff range is RLH > 60% (lesions spreading into flag leaf blade and panicle). Symptom: Infection covering entire plant height including panicle; tillers rotting at base leading to severe lodging.

metadata.name: Sheath Blight
metadata.cutoff_range: RLH > 60% (lesions spreading into flag leaf blade and panicle)

provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

text: Severity tier 'early' (SES Scale 1-3) for Rice Tungro Virus (RTV): Cutoff range is <5% infected hills in isolated patches. Symptom: Slight stunting; light yellow or pale green discoloration on youngest emerging leaves of isolated hills.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Severity tier 'moderate' (SES Scale 5) for Rice Tungro Virus (RTV): Cutoff range is 6%-15% infected hills. Symptom: Marked stunting; vivid yellow to orange-yellow leaf discoloration starting from tips; reduced tillering.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Severity tier 'severe' (SES Scale 7) for Rice Tungro Virus (RTV): Cutoff range is 16%-30% infected hills. Symptom: Severe plant stunting, rusty orange discoloration, delayed flowering, and partial emergence of sterile panicles.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Severity tier 'severe_spreading' (SES Scale 9) for Rice Tungro Virus (RTV): Cutoff range is >30% infected hills across field. Symptom: Field-wide epidemic; severe stunting with entire crop turning orange-yellow; total grain yield loss.
provenance: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

text: Chemical Prescription: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC for Stem borer, Leaf folder. Dosage: 150 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 47 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Low mammalian toxicity). Notes: CIBRC registered for Rice Stem Borer and Leaf Folder. Safe to natural enemies.

Chemical Prescription: Buprofezin 25 SC for Brown planthopper (BPH), Green leafhopper (GLH). Dosage: 400-800 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Insect Growth Regulator). Notes: CIBRC approved for rice hoppers. Direct spray to base of tillers.

Chemical Prescription: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL for Green leafhopper (GLH), Brown planthopper (BPH). Dosage: 100-125 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 21 days. Toxicity: Yellow Label (Neonicotinoid). Notes: Approved for rice hoppers; suppresses GLH vector to prevent Tungro virus transmission.

Chemical Prescription: Thiamethoxam 25 WG for Thrips, Stem borer, GLH. Dosage: 100 g/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 14 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Neonicotinoid). Notes: Approved for rice thrips and stem borer. Suitable for nursery and tillering.

Chemical Prescription: Carbofuran 3G for Stem borer, Gall midge, Whorl maggot. Dosage: 33 kg/ha at planting. Regulatory Status: RESTRICTED (Restricted / Phased Ban). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 60 days. Toxicity: Red Label (Class Ib High Toxicity). Notes: Carbamate with high avian and groundwater toxicity. Restricted/banned across several states. Requires warning.

Chemical Prescription: Malathion 50 EC for Earhead bug. Dosage: 500-1000 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: RESTRICTED (Approved with Strict PHI). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 10 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Organophosphate). Notes: Applied during grain milking; high grain residue risk. Mandatory minimum 7-10 days PHI.

Chemical Prescription: Copper hydroxide 77 WP for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB), False Smut, Bacterial Leaf Streak (BLS). Dosage: 1.25 kg/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 15 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Inorganic Copper). Notes: Approved for bacterial blight and false smut. Apply preventively at boot leaf.

Chemical Prescription: Tricyclazole 75 WP for Rice Blast (Leaf & Neck). Dosage: 500 g/ha (0.6 g/L water). Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Triazole). Notes: Gold standard blasticide; highly systemic; prevents appressorial melanization.

Chemical Prescription: Isoprothiolane 40 EC for Rice Blast. Dosage: 750 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Dithiolane). Notes: Approved for rice blast; inhibits phospholipid biosynthesis.

Chemical Prescription: Hexaconazole 5 SC / 5 EC for Sheath Blight. Dosage: 1000 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Triazole). Notes: Systemic triazole fungicide targeting ergosterol biosynthesis.

Chemical Prescription: Validamycin 3 L for Sheath Blight. Dosage: 1000 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 14 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Antibiotic/Fungicide). Notes: Antibiotic fungicide derived from Streptomyces hygroscopicus; inhibits trehalase.

Chemical Prescription: Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole 18.2% + 11.4% SC (29.6 SC) for Sheath Blight, Rice Blast. Dosage: 500 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 31 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Strobilurin + Triazole). Notes: Broad-spectrum combination with dual translaminar and systemic modes of action.

Chemical Prescription: Propiconazole 25 EC for Sheath Rot, False Smut. Dosage: 500 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Yellow Label (Triazole). Notes: Approved for sheath rot and false smut. Must be applied at booting stage for false smut.

Chemical Prescription: Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride 90:10 SP + 50 WP for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB). Dosage: 100 g + 500 g per hectare. Regulatory Status: RESTRICTED (Restricted / Under Review). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Red/Yellow Label (Agricultural Antibiotic). Notes: Streptocycline is an antibiotic subject to Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) regulatory restrictions in Indian agriculture. Non-antibiotic alternatives (Copper Hydroxide) preferred.
